refnamediv.refpurpose: Get the message headers in their original order

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public arrayRdKafka\Message::getHeaderPairs
Returns every header of the message as a [name, value] pair, in the order they appear in the message. Unlike RdKafka\Message::$headers, repeated names are kept and headers without a value have a &null; value.
Header names are returned up to their first null byte, because librdkafka does not return the length of header names.
For messages returned by the extension, the pairs are the message's original headers, even if RdKafka\Message::$headers is changed later. For a message that was created in PHP, or serialized by an earlier version, the pairs are built from the current RdKafka\Message::$headers, with values converted to strings.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a list of pairs. Each pair is an array holding the header name as a string and its value as a string or &null;.
